title: Protocol for labeling and fixation of intact lysosomes with esterified amino acid analogs to assess lysosomal expansion in living eukaryotic cells
protocol: Plate Lamp1-mGFP-expressing HeLa cells on clean, sterile coverslips.
Trypsinize cells in exponential growth phase between passage 3 and 20.
Remove culture medium from the cells gently.
Wash cells once with pre-warmed PBS.
Add trypsin to detach the cells.
Place cells back into the incubator.
Ensure cells are at a single-cell level after trypsinization by checking under a microscope.
Resuspend trypsinized cells in culture medium.
Remove trypsin from the cell suspension through gentle centrifugation and aspiration of medium.
Resuspend the cell pellet in an appropriate volume or concentration of culture medium.
Prepare sterile coverslips using appropriate forceps.
Clean coverslips with 1% Sodium Dodecyl Sulfate (SDS) if necessary.
Wash coverslips extensively with deionized water after cleaning.
Sterilize coverslips at 200°C for 2 hours if not sterile.
Wash coverslips once with 1× PBS.
Push coverslips gently to the bottom of the well(s) with sterile forceps after cell seeding.
Plate cells on coverslips.
Seed cells to achieve about 50% confluency.
Move multi-well extensively in multiple directions to avoid formation of cell clusters.
Coat coverslips with specific adhesion agents depending on the cell type used if necessary.
Push gently the coverslips to the bottom of the well(s) using a sterile tip.
Place cells in humidified incubator at 37°C and 5% CO2 for 16 hours before proceeding.
Treat cells with amino acid analog.
Dilute amino acid analog stock solution in culture medium at the desired concentration.
Remove culture medium gently from cells.
Add culture medium supplemented with amino acid analogs to cells.
Place cells back into the incubator for 2 hours.
Pour pure methanol into a multi-well or plastic support needed for fixation.
Place the methanol-containing multi-well in a refrigerator set to -20°C.
Wait approximately 15 minutes.
Remove multi-well from refrigerator and place on ice.
Transfer coverslips containing cells using appropriate forceps into cold methanol.
Wait 5 minutes.
Aspirate methanol.
Wash with 1× PBS by performing 4 or 5 rapid washes before proceeding to immunostaining step or confocal microscopy analysis.
Aspirate culture medium from the cells.
Wash the cells once with 1× PBS at room temperature.
Fix the cells by adding a mixture of 4% paraformaldehyde and 0.05% glutaraldehyde prepared in 0.2M HEPES buffer.
Incubate for 10 minutes before proceeding to further analysis or staining.
Wash cells once with 4% PFA in 0.2M HEPES buffer.
Add 4% PFA and incubate at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Wash cells three times with 1× PBS solution.
Aspirate culture medium and wash cells one time with 1× PBS at room temperature.
Fix cells by adding formaldehyde solution (3.7% in 1× PBS) and incubate at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Prepare glycine-based blocking solution (0.1M Gly in 1× PBS) on ice.
Aspirate fixation solution and replace with glycine-based blocking solution.
Incubate cells on ice for 5 minutes.
Wash cells two times with 1× PBS before proceeding with immunostaining protocol.
Permeabilize cells using blocking buffer (0.05% saponin, 1% bovine serum albumin in 1× PBS) for 15 min at room temperature.
Dilute anti-Lamp1 antibody to a ratio of 1:500 in blocking buffer.
Wash cells once with 1× PBS at 25°C.
Mix the diluted antibody by inverting or vortexing, and spin down briefly.
Prepare a rectangle of parafilm on the working bench using water drops for adhesion.
Add 50 μL of the diluted primary antibody solution to the center of the parafilm.
Gently place the coverslip upside-down with cells contacting the drop of antibody-containing solution.
Incubate for 1 hour at room temperature.
Remove excess PBS solution from the coverslip by touching it to adsorbing paper.
Add 150 μl of 1× PBS between parafilm and coverslip to let it float on the drops.
Wash cells three times with 1× PBS for 5 min each.
Dilute Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated secondary antibodies at a ratio of 1:500 using blocking buffer.
Mix the diluted secondary antibodies by inverting or vortexing, and spin down for a second.
Add 50 μl drops of the diluted secondary antibodies solution.
Incubate for 45 min at RT.
Wash cells three times with 1× PBS for 5 min each.
Add 10 μL of mounting solution on the slide.
Dip coverslips in sterile water before placing them on the drop of mounting solution to remove any trace of salts.
Let them dry in a dark chamber before proceeding with microscopy analysis.
Switch on the microscope and set up parameters to the thermostatic chamber to let it reach the selected temperature and CO2.
Observe samples using an oil immersion objective (63× 1.4 NA).
Set channel to 488-nm laser by using the Ultraview VoX spinning disk software.
Adjust the laser power to 50%.
Set the time exposure between 200 and 500 ms.
Capture images from at least 20 different fields for lysosomal diameter quantification.
Save acquired images in .Tiff, .JPG or .PNG formats.
Process images using Ultraview VoX spinning disk software to adjust intensity.
Analyze images using ImageJ Fiji software for quantitative analysis.
Observe samples with a confocal microscope equipped with a 63× or 40× 1.4 NA oil immersion objective.
Set the channel to 488-nm laser using the LSM700 Zeiss software.
Adjust the pinhole setting to 0.42 A.U.
Set the laser power to 2.0.
Adjust PMT gain between 500 and 700.
Set the offset at -20.
Capture images from at least 20 different fields for three independent experiments.
Analyze at least 50 lysosomal diameters per experiment, totaling 3000 lysosomal diameters for statistical significance.
Save acquired images in ".lsm5" format.
Open saved images using LSM700 or ImageJ Fiji software.
Export images to .Tiff, .JPG, .PNG formats for further analysis.
